title: 卖了两家公司：却在麦当劳换衣服，一年打100座球场图什么？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: After starting two successful companies in his 20s, Daniel Belk is tackling a new challenge.
segments.zh: 二十多岁创办两家成功公司后，丹尼尔·贝尔克正迎接新挑战。

segments.en: He is attempting to play 100 top-ranked public golf courses in America in one year.
segments.zh: 他计划一年内打遍美国100个顶级公共高尔夫球场。

segments.en: After I sold those companies, there was nothing material that I really wanted to buy, but I wanted to give myself a cool experience.
segments.zh: 卖掉公司后，没什么特别想买的，但想给自己一次酷炫体验。

segments.en: I kind of felt like it was a fun way to also invest in myself, so not only was I giving myself a cool experience, but also maybe giving myself an opportunity to launch another career.
segments.zh: 我觉得这也是对自己的一种投入，不仅体验酷炫，还可能开启新事业。

segments.en: The Denver-based entrepreneur is on track to spend $70,000 for the year.
segments.zh: 这位丹佛企业家今年预计花费7万美元。

segments.en: The challenge is taking him to 29 states and he's spending thousands of dollars on flights and t-times.
segments.zh: 挑战带他走遍29个州，机票和开球时间花费数千美元。

segments.en: To cut down on expenses, he's spending much of the year living and traveling in RVs.
segments.zh: 为节省开支，他全年大部分时间住在房车里旅行。

segments.en: I give you all a little insight of what it looks like traveling behind the scenes right now.
segments.zh: 给大家看看我现在幕后旅行的样子。

segments.en: I'm changing clothes at the Mickey D's. The logistics are pretty intensive. I'm doing all of the like the travel logistics on my own, so booking t-times gets really tough.
segments.zh: 我在麦当劳换衣服。行程安排很紧张，所有旅行后勤都自己搞定，订开球时间特别难。

segments.en: And a lot of courses you can only book t-times two weeks in advance. Some courses you can only book in four days in advance.
segments.zh: 很多球场只能提前两周预订，有些只能提前四天。

segments.en: Some days you can book a month in advance, so it really changes course to course to course to course.
segments.zh: 有些日子可以提前一个月预订，所以每个球场情况都不同。

segments.en: And it's just, yeah, as you can imagine, trying to play 100 courses all over the country is logistically intensive.
segments.zh: 而且，正如你所想，在全国打100个球场，后勤安排非常密集。

segments.en: Belk made his money in real estate private equity and by co-founding a run club company, which he sold his stake in for $1 million.
segments.zh: 贝尔克通过房地产私募股权和联合创办一家跑步俱乐部公司赚钱，他以100万美元出售了股份。

segments.en: He decided to spend the year golfing to travel, see friends, and enjoy some of his wealth.
segments.zh: 他决定花一年时间打高尔夫，去旅行、见朋友，享受自己的财富。

segments.en: But he also did it to lay the groundwork for his next move.
segments.zh: 但他这样做也是为了给下一步行动奠定基础。

segments.en: Belk has turned himself into a golf influencer.
segments.zh: 贝尔克把自己变成了高尔夫影响者。
